back_translation: Hear now what the LORD says: Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.
Hear, O mountains, the lawsuit of the LORD, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for the LORD has a case against His people, and He will contend with Israel.
O My people, what have I done to you? With what have I wearied you? Answer Me!
For I brought you up from the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery; I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to lead you.
O My people, remember what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam son of Beor answered him; remember the events from Shittim to Gilgal, so that you may know the righteous acts of the LORD.
With what shall I come before the LORD and bow before God on high? Shall I come before Him with burnt offerings, with year-old calves?
Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams or with ten thousand rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
O man, He has shown you what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to do justice, to love steadfast kindness, and to walk humbly with your God?
The voice of the LORD cries out to the city, and to fear His name is true wisdom. Hear, O tribe and assembly of the city!
Are there still in the house of the wicked treasures gained by wickedness, and the short measure that is accursed?
Shall I acquit the man who uses dishonest scales and a bag of deceitful weights?
The rich men of the city are full of violence; its inhabitants speak lies, and their tongues are deceitful.
Therefore I have begun to strike you severely, making you desolate because of your sins.
You will eat but not be satisfied; hunger will remain within you. You will store up but cannot keep it, and what you do keep I will give over to the sword.
You will sow but not reap; you will tread olives but not anoint yourself with oil; you will tread grapes but not drink the wine.

For you have kept the statutes of Omri and followed all the works of the house of Ahab, and you have walked in their counsels. Therefore I will make you a desolation and your inhabitants an object of scorn, and you will bear the reproach of My people.
